# Keep draft recovery available through browser back and forward navigation

## What & Why
The current regression coverage exercises sidebar navigation, but browser history navigation can mount the same views through a different lifecycle. Covering it will catch recovery notices being lost when users use the browser controls.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity recovery notices remain available after navigating back and forward across the two views.
- A still-valid draft can be reopened after the history navigation.
- Expired drafts still announce that they are no longer available.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
